description: This file defines an abstract class `GenericMapEntrySet` that extends `GenericMapSet`, providing set-like behavior for map entries within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for containment checks and removal of entries, operating on a source map.

classes.name: GenericMapEntrySet
classes.description: An abstract class representing a set of map entries, providing containment and removal operations based on underlying source map.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the set contains a specific map entry by key and value.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific map entry from the source map if it exists.

search-terms: Abstract class for map entry sets
